visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three women are sitting side-by-side on a light blue seat inside a subway car. The woman on the left has long red hair, wearing a black low-cut top, white skirt, and black stockings. The woman in the center has brown hair, a grey zip-up jacket, and a blue face mask. The woman on the right has black hair, a white striped cardigan over a white top, and a light blue skirt. They are looking down at their laps or phones. (2) A hand enters the foreground from the bottom, gesturing in a swinging motion as if holding an invisible pendulum. The three women immediately begin to sway their upper bodies and heads in synchronized left-to-right movements, following the rhythm of the hand. Their facial expressions shift from neutral to wide smiles and laughter. (3) The swaying continues with increasing synchronization. The woman on the left puts her hands together, while the woman on the right holds her bag and phone, all keeping their eyes on the gesturing hand. The subway background shows yellow handrails and a route map with the station 'Nangang' visible on the door.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous short-form comedy sketch designed for social media engagement. It uses the visual trope of a 'pendulum' (represented by a hand) to induce a synchronized, hypnotic-like swaying motion in three friends on a subway. The intent is to showcase camaraderie and create a relatable 'friend group' moment through rhythmic physical comedy.
